items.title: Two consecutive admissible monomorphisms of dg modules give triangles satisfying TR4
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dga.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-two-split-injections at source lines 1285-1292: for a differential graded algebra A and admissible monomorphisms of dg A-modules alpha : K -> L and beta : L -> M, there are distinguished triangles (K,L,Q_1), (K,M,Q_2) and (L,M,Q_3) for which the octahedral axiom TR4 holds. The proof at source lines 1294-1341 is a construction rather than a citation: it chooses left inverses pi_1 and pi_3 for the two admissible monomorphisms, builds the composite left inverse pi_2, identifies the three cokernels with the kernels of the left inverses, exhibits the resulting direct-sum decompositions Q_2 = Q_1 direct sum Q_3, displays the three-row commutative diagram of admissible short exact sequences, argues that the downward arrows are compatible with the chosen splittings and therefore define morphisms of the corresponding distinguished triangles, and finally computes that the connecting morphism delta of the split triangle is the composite Q_3 -> L[1] -> Q_1[1], which is exactly the TR4 datum. Every step is a separate compatibility check and the statement mentions none of them. No cross-chapter result is invoked inside the retained span.
